pages.text: Kiboko Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Moyo Asset Managers (SYN). Kiboko Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to generate regular income from government and corporate bonds. The management fee of Kiboko Bond Fund is 2.2 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Kiboko Bond Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 100. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Kiboko Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 10.6 percent.

Withdrawals from Kiboko Bond Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Kiboko Bond Fund are bank bonds (50 percent), infrastructure bonds (40 percent) and Treasury bonds (30 percent). Bara Custodial (SYN) acts as trustee of Kiboko Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Kiboko Bond Fund was launched in 2022 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
